failures.observation: Tuindorp archive exceeds 2.7 GB; a bounded full-download probe stopped at its acquisition budget.
failures.resolution: Use ETag-consistent ZIP ranges, selected member SHA-256 and ZIP CRC. No bulk simulations or learned weights are used.

failures.observation: DMI raw hourly precipitation query contained missing intervals.
failures.resolution: Reject missing-to-zero fill; use independently harvested quality-controlled climateData acc_precip with explicit intervals/validity. The selected downloaded window admits 30 August candidate days in Odense and 31 in Utrecht.

failures.observation: Initial native-library search path was wrong; global LD_LIBRARY_PATH then shadowed the toolkit output ABI (undefined SMO_getDateTime).
failures.resolution: Original CLI gets its own install RPATH; no global native-library override.

failures.observation: Original EPA report contains a single-byte superscript-three heading; UTF-8 decoding failed.
failures.resolution: Preserve raw bytes and use declared CP1252 report decoding.

failures.observation: MCP SDK 1-style property names and timedelta timeout were incompatible with the pinned SDK 2 client.
failures.resolution: Use actual SDK 2 snake_case fields and numeric timeout; final protocol tests execute the client.

failures.observation: Original Linux parent-force-kill test failed: 21 passed, one failed.
failures.resolution: Marked process-lifetime portability patch; original source remains pristine.

failures.observation: Initial PDEATHSIG approach passed short tests but long AnyIO sessions died when a creator thread retired. Original batch metadata also queried balances after close and returned misleading zeros.
failures.resolution: Process pidfd watcher outside the worker GIL; public PySWMM after-end capture before close. Fresh v2 workspaces and task; v1 raw observations retained.

failures.observation: Odense original idle-reaping test observed CLOSED before worker accounting finished (active_workers 1 instead of 0); Utrecht passed.
failures.resolution: Synchronize the internal state getter with the existing teardown lock; deterministic regression and unchanged original suite pass. Failed CI attempt retained.

failures.observation: Hermes Odense never completed output_query_snapshot: it repeatedly used live flooding as a binary attribute. Generic errors hid that problem and a full two-worker budget.
failures.resolution: Publish original binary vocabulary in schema enums/status; safe domain ToolError messages, exact lifecycle URIs and explicit slot/lifecycle ordering. Preserve all v2 observations; use fresh v3 workspaces.

failures.observation: All final operations, complete numeric artifacts/pages, binary queries and JSON claims pass. Both Hermes prose briefs still fail factual/length review.
failures.resolution: Preserve raw answers and answer-hash-bound negative verdicts. Do not treat correct JSON or low continuity error as accepted municipal advice.

private_raw_logs_preserved: .urban-mcp; excluded from Git because full host logs can contain reasoning/configuration. Public exports contain only reviewed tool calls, answers and process receipts.
